## SessionLock class

Distributed session lock using atomic Redis leases.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class SessionLock 
```

## Remarks

Acquires a `SET NX PX` lease on the session key (auto-expiring after `leaseMs`<!-- -->) so concurrent updates for the same user/chat are serialized or skipped across instances. Release is atomic via Lua (owned-release).
